# Example Data Docs

## Documentation

- [Welcome](https://docs.example-data.test/intro.md): What the data covers.
- [Authorization](https://docs.example-data.test/auth.md): Send your key in the apikey header.
- [Credits](https://docs.example-data.test/credits.md): Search is free; each full record costs 20 credits.
- [Company search](https://docs.example-data.test/company/search.md): Find company ids with Elasticsearch DSL.
- [Company collect](https://docs.example-data.test/company/collect.md): One full company record by id.
- [Job search](https://docs.example-data.test/jobs/search.md): Find job post ids.
- [Job collect](https://docs.example-data.test/jobs/collect.md): One job post by id.
